description: Screenshot (dark mode) of a tweet from President Donald Trump (@realDonaldTrump) posted May 31, 2020, stating the United States will designate ANTIFA a terrorist organization. Engagement counts show 28.1K retweets and 58.5K likes.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. The United States of America will be designating ANTIFA as a Terrorist Organization. 12:23 PM · May 31, 2020 · Twitter for iPhone. 28.1K Retweets. 58.5K Likes
flags: The tweet announces an intended designation; no formal legal mechanism for such a domestic designation was enacted.

description: iPad Safari screenshot (taken Sun May 31, 4:21 PM) of a Donald Trump (@realDonaldTrump) quote-tweet reading “STRENGTH!” over a tweet from QAnon-promoting account @SeanCordicon. The quoted tweet references “the calm before the storm,” quotes Ronald Reagan on refusing to accommodate and retreat, and carries the hashtags #GodWins and #WWG1WGA. The embedded video thumbnail shows a family raising a large American flag on the porch of a house numbered 202.
text: Safari. 4:21 PM. Sun May 31. 21%. Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. STRENGTH!. S⭐E⭐A⭐N @SeanCordicon · 1d. We knew this moment would arrive. We are the calm before, during & after the storm. “If we continue to accommodate, continue to back and retreat, eventually we have to face the final demand -- the ultimatum. And what then?”. –Reagan. #GodWins #WWG1WGA. 202. CRY HAVOC and let slip THE DOGS OF WAR. Tweet your reply
flags: Reagan quotation is presented by the tweet without sourcing; it paraphrases his 1964 “A Time for Choosing” speech.
People in the video thumbnail are private individuals and are not identified.

description: Production still of the volcano rocket-base set from the 1967 James Bond film You Only Live Twice, designed by Ken Adam and built at Pinewood Studios. Inside a hollowed-out volcano crater, uniformed extras in orange and white jumpsuits surround a white rocket on a launch gantry, with a monorail, control platforms and a retractable crater roof overhead. The set depicts the secret SPECTRE lair of villain Blofeld.
flags: Identification of the film set is from the source filename plus the set’s distinctive, widely published design.

description: Two-panel comparison image. Top panel: a video clip styled as an MSNBC “BREAKING NEWS / LIVE” broadcast with the chyron “Curfews imposed across U.S. as protesters hit the streets,” showing an aerial view of a smoking, burning Philadelphia skyline; small text by the MSNBC logo reads “BAD SCOOTER NOT REAL.” Bottom panel: the identical aerial shot at 1:45 in the YouTube upload “World War Z - Official Trailer (HD)” (Nov 8, 2012), demonstrating the “news” clip is built from 2013 zombie-film footage, not real protest coverage.
text: PHILADELPHIA. BREAKING NEWS. CURFEWS IMPOSED ACROSS U.S. AS PROTESTERS HIT THE STREETS. LIVE. BAD SCOOTER NOT REAL. MSNBC. 46.6K views. 0:02 / 0:08. 6:01 PM MT. 1:45 / 2:26. World War Z - Official Trailer (HD). 37,980,091 views · Nov 8, 2012. 112K. 13K. SHARE. SAVE
flags: The MSNBC-styled clip is not a genuine MSNBC broadcast — it is a parody built from World War Z trailer footage, and its own watermark reads “NOT REAL”; the image documents this fabrication.

description: Screenshot of a New York Daily News article by Denis Slattery, June 1, 2020: “Cuomo warns protests could spark coronavirus comeback in New York.” The lead photo shows Gov. Andrew Cuomo at his daily coronavirus briefing at the New Settlement Community Center in the Bronx, seated beside an unnamed aide before a screen reading “Rodney King – George Floyd, 30 Years / Injustice in criminal justice is abhorrent.” A sidebar lists related coronavirus and George Floyd protest headlines.
